claims.text: Large Language Models hold potential for network operations involving text data, fault data, and log files.
This paper introduces a framework leveraging Large Language Models for intelligent network operations and performance optimization.
Intelligent networks encounter key technical barriers in real-time network monitoring.
Intelligent networks encounter key technical barriers in providing timely alerts.

evidence.description: Abstract states LLMs showcase emergent capabilities in natural language tasks and hold great potential for network operations that involve vast amounts of text data, fault data, and log files.
Abstract states that the paper introduces a framework for intelligent network operations and performance optimization leveraging LLM.
Abstract notes technical barriers faced by intelligent networks, specifically efficiently monitoring networks in real-time.
Abstract notes technical barriers faced by intelligent networks, specifically providing timely alerts when necessary.

methodologies.name: LLM-based Intelligent Network Operations and Performance Optimization Framework
methodologies.description: A conceptual framework leveraging large language models to enhance network robustness and deliver personalized network services.

limitations.text: Intelligent networks face technical barriers in efficiently monitoring networks in real-time and providing timely alerts.
LLM-based intelligent network operations face challenges hindering comprehensive deployment.

future_work.text: Developing potential solutions to overcome deployment challenges in LLM-based intelligent network operations and performance optimization.
